item.title: Big holes in grass ! Some on the football pitch been filled in with solid but loads of deep ones still in the park - HALF A JOB DONE ! Need filling I. ASAP ! Lots people and dogs falling in them . While you’re there. The pathway has massive cracks and some small stiles inserted 2 weeks ago but not all and still waiting for pitch over - again HALF A JOB ! The grass, the path is UNSAFE and a big risk of INJURY ,slips trips and falls small children going to school . NEEDS ATTENTION ASAP ! How much would it cost you if someone reports a sprain or injury ?????>. My guess is a lot ! You have a duty of care !!! Do it , do it now !, 16th October
item.description:
Park riddled with large holes in the ground that are high risk of injury to persons, children animals - some on the football pitch done recently but not nearly enough. The football pitch is still not adequate either - half a job done !!!!! While you are there , some small stones have been put in the pathway about 35 % of the way , but that was 2 or more weeks ago, the remaining need to be stoned and pitch over - THIS IS A WALKWAT}Y FOR CHILDREN TO SCHOOL OLD PEOPLE. GENERAL PUBLIC, ANIMALS. I have seen small children slip, trip and fall on them . YOU HAVE A DUTY OF CARE TO MAINTAIN TO A REASONABLE STANDARD - HOW MUCH WILL AN INDECENT COST YOU ????£££££££££. There is going to be if you don’t sort this out . I am monitoring how fact you act on this serious issue - already spoke to the parks inspector 2 times !!!
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Persimmon Gardens, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
